Two large, spherical fireworks dominate the scene, their golden hues radiating outward in intricate patterns. original_wisa_caption:
The video captures a breathtaking fireworks display over a serene body of water at night. The sky is dark, providing a stark contrast to the vibrant explosions of light. Two large, spherical fireworks dominate the scene, their golden hues radiating outward in intricate patterns. These fireworks gradually fade into smaller bursts, creating a mesmerizing visual effect. As the display progresses, additional fireworks light up the sky, adding layers of color and complexity to the already stunning spectacle.

The water below reflects the fireworks, mirroring their brilliance and creating a symmetrical beauty. The reflections shimmer and dance, enhancing the overall visual impact. In the distance, faint lights from buildings and structures are visible, suggesting an urban or suburban setting. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to fully absorb the grandeur of the fireworks and their reflection on the water. The video concludes with the final remnants of the fireworks fading away, leaving only the calm, reflective surface of the water and the quiet night sky.
caption:
The video captures a nighttime scene over a calm pond. A broad cluster of golden-white firework bursts, three overlapping spherical peony-like explosions, already fills the dark sky above a low city skyline dotted with lights. Throughout the view the cluster persists, its radial streaks lengthening and drooping slightly downward while the bright core points drift apart, slowly increasing the apparent diameter of the burst as the outer glow softens toward the edges and the smoke haze lingers below.

The overhead fireworks and the distant skyline are mirrored as a shimmering reflection on the water. This reflection deforms in step with the expanding burst above, its bright patches stretching vertically across the surface. A dark paddlewheel-like device sits in the water on the right with its own reflection. A small floating structure is visible mid-frame. The horizon framing stays constant, with no pan, tilt, or zoom evident. The skyline lights and the water objects remain fixed in position. The fireworks continue to spread without fading during the view.

endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.

claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.

processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.
